key.name: widgets
key.description: Stores the JSON representation of all active widgets.

key.name: global-background-color
key.description: Default background color for all widgets.

key.name: global-foreground-color
key.description: Default foreground/text color for all widgets.

key.name: global-card-color
key.description: Raised surface color used for headers and secondary controls. Empty derives it from the background color.

key.name: global-highlight-color
key.description: Stronger surface color used for active states, borders and chart tracks. Empty derives it from the background color.

key.name: show-grid
key.description: Visualize the underlying widget placement grid.

key.name: calendar-first-day
key.description: Override the first weekday shown in Month Calendar; -1 follows the locale.

key.name: calendar-weekend-accent
key.description: Use the accent color for selected weekend days.

key.name: calendar-weekend-days
key.description: Days shown with accent styling in Month Calendar; select at most two.

key.name: global-font-family
key.description: The font family to use across widgets.

key.name: global-use-custom-font
key.description: If true, widgets use the configured custom font family instead of the system font.

key.name: weather-dynamic-color
key.description: Change the background color of weather widgets based on the current condition and time of day.

key.name: weather-dynamic-image
key.description: Show a weather-specific overlay image based on the current condition.

key.name: image-animate-gif
key.description: If true, animated GIFs will play. If false, only their first frame is rendered.

key.name: weather-use-fahrenheit
key.description: If true, weather widgets will display temperatures in Fahrenheit instead of Celsius by default.

key.name: time-format-24h
key.description: If true, time widgets will display the time in 24-hour format instead of 12-hour format.

key.name: image-show-caption
key.description: If true, show captions on image widgets.

key.name: slideshow-show-caption
key.description: If true, show captions on slideshow widgets.

key.name: image-caption-scrim
key.description: If true, fade a dark gradient behind image and slideshow captions so they stay readable over a light picture.

key.name: global-caption-color
key.description: Caption text color for image and slideshow widgets that follow the global setting.

key.name: show-desktop-icons
key.description: Draw the contents of the user's desktop folder on the widget grid. Entries are kept while this is off so switching it back on restores their positions.

key.name: confirm-widget-delete
key.description: Ask before a widget is removed from the desktop. Removing one also deletes its saved data and cannot be undone.

key.name: show-app-launchers
key.description: Draw the application launchers chosen below on the widget grid, alongside the files in the desktop folder. They are entries rather than files: there is nothing in the folder to move or delete.

key.name: app-launchers
key.description: Desktop IDs of the launchers to show, such as org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop. Ids that no longer resolve are ignored, so uninstalling an app removes it from the grid.

key.name: show-hidden-desktop-icons
key.description: Include dotfiles from the desktop folder. Turning this off drops their grid entries, so switching it back on places them at the next free spot.

key.name: dismissed-desktop-icons
key.description: Names of desktop folder entries hidden from the grid. The files themselves are never touched and each entry keeps its place, so clearing this list brings every one of them back where it was.

key.name: cut-selected-icon
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that puts the selected desktop icon on the clipboard as a cut, the way a file manager does. Unbound by default: extensions.gnome.org does not allow an extension to ship a default shortcut that touches the clipboard. Has no effect until an icon is selected.

key.name: copy-selected-icon
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that puts the selected desktop icon on the clipboard as a copy, the way a file manager does. Unbound by default: extensions.gnome.org does not allow an extension to ship a default shortcut that touches the clipboard. Has no effect until an icon is selected.

key.name: rename-selected-icon
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the rename entry on the selected desktop icon, the way a file manager does. Has no effect until an icon is selected.

key.name: global-monitor
key.description: Choose default monitor display mode for widgets.

key.name: open-edit-widget-id
key.description: Internal key set when right-clicking a widget to open its edit dialog in preferences.

key.name: theme
key.description: The currently selected theme preset ID.

key.name: last-selected-theme
key.description: The last predefined theme used as the starting point for Custom mode.

key.name: accent-color-override
key.description: Accent color used by the Custom theme. Adwaita themes use the GNOME system accent.
